 Today’s Gold Rate in India October 26: Gold prices up in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru
 22, 24 carat Gold prices up across metro cities on October 26
 By R Dinakaran 
 Updated - October 26, 2026 at 02:15 PM. × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/gold-rate-today/gold-price-today-in-delhi-mumbai-kolkata-chennai-bengaluru-hyderabad-pune-gold-rates-metro-cities-october-26-2026/article71626053.ece Copy Gold prices rose across most metro cities today compared to yesterday.
